notes.title: YUKI - Immersive Reality Technical Achievement nominee at D.I.C.E. AWARDS 2022
notes.notes:
Hey there, rangers!

#DICEAwards 2022 is almost here, and we are thrilled to announce that we are one of the nominees for Immersive Reality Technical Achievement! 🚀

We had a very dedicated team behind YUKI, from UI to lore creation, from production to QA, and all the other parts of its creation of course. In our book, everyone in our team is already a winner! Not to mention you! Yes, you, the player! If it wasn't for you YUKI wouldn't have this recognition from festivals, so from the bottom of our space rangers hearts thank you!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/7a9107b89f67efa969295000543dcfeac5bf0c60.gif[/img]

The 25th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards will be live Feb. 24 at 8:00PM PT with streaming TBD according to the Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences, so keep an eye on our social media to know the exact link to click when it's on!

Instagram: [url=instagram.com/YUKIVRGAME]instagram.com/YUKIVRGAME[/url]
Twitter: [url=twitter.com/YUKIVRGAME]twitter.com/YUKIVRGAME[/url]
JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER: [url=https://discord.gg/AZ8fjvuzhc]https://discord.gg/AZ8fjvuzhc[/url]

It's an honor for us to be together with other great games in this competition, but as always fingers crossed for us! 🤞

notes.title: Have a chance to win a YUKI Statue!
notes.notes:
Have you ever considered yourself lucky? This could be your chance to have an exclusive YUKI statue!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/4155670a5990f7a8ee715bb4d81d5f7da26760c9.gif[/img]

We here at ARVORE partnered with [url=https://www.tesseract3d.com.br][b]Tesseract 3D[/b][/url], a top-quality 3D creator studio in Brazil, to bring Yuki to the physical world for the first time ever! The best part, we made it especially thinking of giving this unique statue away for a very lucky YUKI fan. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/a502d6387d1f232b6bd308673c06854caa501f33.gif[/img]

YUKI is a game that we made with all our hearts. We dedicated lots of time creating a world that could communicate with our players in the best way possible. Ever since the early days of development, we noticed our community asking to have Yuki physically in their hands. Don't miss the opportunity to try your luck and have this awesome statue in your collection to celebrate YUKI and the holiday season.

Good luck! 🤞

notes.title: Nominate YUKI for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hey there, rangers!

[b]The Steam Awards 2021 are on![/b] You know what is cooler? YUKI can be nominated for VR Game of the Year! 🚀

YUKI was created with lots of love from everyone on our team, from narrative designers to game devs and soundtrack. Everything was created to suit what the community would need to have the greatest of the experiences when playing such a unique mix of genres, especially in VR.

Creating a mix of bullet-hell and roguelike, two very different and challenging genres, and yet delivering a pleasant experience was not a piece of cake, but it sure is as delicious as a good pie!

From day 1 when we launched 'til this day our community of players is being great when it comes to giving us support, we couldn't be more grateful! 💜

Now, once again, the power is in your hands to help us here at the YUKI team to have another great achievement! We're counting on your vote for VR [b]Game of the Year[/b]! 

Fingers crossed 🤞

notes.title: Angle correction + Difficulty Balance + Quality of Life UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/390f676a635735faf04e41330dba4fec1f05e566.png[/img]

Hi, Space Rangers!
We made some adjustments to YUKI! Nothing major, but since our community was asking for them we decided to implement them already so everyone could enjoy our game the best way possible :)

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Angle Offset correction for Vive and Index controllers
[*] Fixed a rare bug where no powerup choice showed up in the power capsule during the run
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a skip button to allow users to bypass the intro screens
[*] Minor balancing improvements
[/list]

We are always getting feedback and suggestions from our awesome community of players. Feel free to [b]join our discord server[/b] to have a good chat, not to mention having access to some YUKI-related freebies and lore material ;)
